# url plugin


```````````````````````````````` example
visit https://lepture.com/
.
<p>visit <a href="https://lepture.com/">https://lepture.com/</a></p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
visit [https://lepture.com/](/foo)
.
<p>visit <a href="/foo">https://lepture.com/</a></p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
visit <a href="/foo">https://lepture.com/</a>
.
<p>visit <a href="/foo">https://lepture.com/</a></p>
````````````````````````````````


## balanced parentheses


```````````````````````````````` example
See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software) for details.
.
<p>See <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software)">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software)</a> for details.</p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software)
.
<p><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software)">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software)</a></p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software).
.
<p>See <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software)">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software)</a>.</p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software),
.
<p>See <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software)">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software)</a>,</p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
(see https://example.com/foo)
.
<p>(see <a href="https://example.com/foo">https://example.com/foo</a>)</p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software))
.
<p>(<a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software)">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown_(software)</a>)</p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
https://x.com/a_(b)_(c)
.
<p><a href="https://x.com/a_(b)_(c)">https://x.com/a_(b)_(c)</a></p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
https://x.com/a((b))
.
<p><a href="https://x.com/a((b))">https://x.com/a((b))</a></p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
https://x.com/a)
.
<p><a href="https://x.com/a">https://x.com/a</a>)</p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
[text https://x.com/a_(b)]
.
<p>[text <a href="https://x.com/a_(b)">https://x.com/a_(b)</a>]</p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
https://example.com/foo.
.
<p><a href="https://example.com/foo">https://example.com/foo</a>.</p>
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
https://example.com/foo;
.
<p><a href="https://example.com/foo">https://example.com/foo</a>;</p>
````````````````````````````````
